name: Bend & Crater Lake
about: Summer (Jul–Sep) is best for Crater Lake's Rim Drive and Bend's mountain biking; winter brings real skiing at Mount Bachelor, though heavy snow closes much of the Rim Drive.
overview: Crater Lake's impossibly deep blue volcanic caldera, paired with Bend — one of America's best mountain-biking and craft-beer towns, with real skiing at Mount Bachelor and renowned fly fishing on the Deschutes River.
costOverview: Bend's craft beer scene and casual food stay reasonable — Mount Bachelor lift tickets and guided rafting trips are the real splurges.
